customManagers.description: Track the pinned Ubuntu base images in python/base-images.json, the source that python/generate_dockerfile.sh copies into the Dockerfiles.

packageRules.description: Both Ubuntu versions are built on purpose: never move a base image to another Ubuntu release, only refresh its digest.
Update the Ubuntu digests of python/base-images.json and of the generated Dockerfiles in one PR, so they stay identical.
